description: This file defines the TimesheetRow class, which represents a row in a timesheet associated with a specific project and activity, managing assignment of timesheet items to dates and calculating totals.

classes.name: TimesheetRow
classes.description: Represents a row of timesheet data for a particular project and activity, including date management and assignment of timesheet items.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetRow with a project, activity, and array of dates.

methods.name: setDates
methods.description: Sets the dates for the timesheet row, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total counted for this timesheet row.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total by a specified amount and returns the new total.

methods.name: assignTimesheetItem
methods.description: Assigns a TimesheetItem to the corresponding date; throws LogicException if a timesheet item is already assigned for that date.

methods.name: getTimesheetItems
methods.description: Returns all TimesheetItems assigned to this timesheet row.
